name: par_misc
verifies: par-misc: the looping hero uses (orc drum needs two drum sticks, saw log needs the saw, water pipe), the Inventory camera mode while a use runs and the zoom reset after it (fix-122: with the option Camera in windows = Original; the default keeps the play camera), a swing that hits the ground (OnItemTouchesLevel)
notes: Needs `G3Cli content import` (InteractiveKind.Activity objects) and `Myrtana/Content/Build interactive visuals` (hero motion library: SitGround/Waterpipe/SawLog/OrcDrum prefixes, the water pipe's _I_ parts). A missing drum stick shows 'HUD_MissingItem_Interact' + the stick's name on the HUD (first use). levelhits counts swings whose blade met the level; on flat ground a normal swing may not touch it (look at the floor first, or hit a wall). Check by hand: the talk box grows in over 200 ms per line, Subtitles off hides it (Audio page), Esc on a station's amount dialog closes only the dialog, sharpening a stack of 2 swords sharpens one. fix-184 (regress-1021b): the Faring orcs are calmed - Orc_Elite_02 came at the hero after the drum and the log stand refused the use (in combat); why it engaged is not in the log (an enemies probe before step 19 would tell).
